entries.name: sbb.ch
entries.reviewed_sections: Restrictions on access; Use of SBB Websites
entries.justification: No express robot/automated-agent clause found; copying/reproduction is limited to personal non-commercial use or needs written consent, so the terms are materially ambiguous for agents. Allowed read-only (no forms, accounts, consent or payment; screenshots in-session only, never published) by owner decision of 2026-11-08: prefer sites whose terms do not forbid agents. Note: Official footer legal-information page fetched. No explicit automation clause found here; copying/public/commercial use restricted. R4-02 normal-browser check 2026-11-09: Individual pages may be saved; public/commercial reuse requires consent. No express robot prohibition found. Tested link did not show a round-trip fare list with party. Existing owner rule is not express permission; no publication, forms, accounts, consent or payment. See docs/evidence/site-policy.md. R6-02 2026-11-09 H showed dated outbound numeric fares for Paris-Milan, Lyon-Milan, Geneva-Milan and Geneva-Zurich under the default Half Fare display. Not proof of full-adult/round-trip preparation. Paris-Zurich had no numeric prices; Geneva-Lucerne retained a loading skeleton/consent banner. R6-02 step 5 observed the Geneva-Zurich fare/ticket selection surface at /en/offer; full selected round-trip evidence and runtime verification are still required. International ticket selection redirected to unreviewed shop.sbb.ch and was blocked; no scope expansion. R6-02 step 6 same-operator scope review 2026-11-09, explicitly approved by owner: shop.sbb.ch is SBB's own ticket shop under the same SBB operator/legal terms already reviewed. Paris-Milan and Lyon-Milan step 5 ticket selection reached /customer/en/alw/onboarding with opaque su/cu query values, blocked only because this host was missing from reviewed scopes. Add only shop.sbb.ch to scopes/navigation; no other hosts, no permission to enter personal data, submit forms, log in, accept consent, book or pay. Onboarding is not a fare checkpoint; retain /en/offer until a distinct shop fare-summary path is observed. Existing review expiry unchanged. Step 6 Paris-Milan live frame identifies /customer/en/alw/onboarding as SwissPass login / purchase-as-guest choice, not a fare offer. Added that exact path as beyond-boundary protection after the smokes; this guard is offline-tested, not live-rerun. PR44 review correction 2026-11-09: /en/offer and its retDay/retMoment/retTime/retTrip query state were already observed with outbound fare only and Select return ticket still pending. No observed URL distinguishes completed return-fare selection. Disable SBB URL force-answer with the existing never-match (?!) sentinel (nonempty lists required by pinned registry/runner validation), preserving all beyond boundaries. Agent answers remain subject to full evidence checks; no URL-based READY claim or live acceptance of this correction.

entries.name: NS International
entries.reviewed_sections: Disclaimer: information, availability, copyright, links and transport conditions
entries.justification: Normal Chrome reread 2026-11-09: the public disclaimer reserves copyright, disclaims accuracy/availability and references transport conditions; no express robot/automation prohibition found in that page. This is not express contractual authorization. Retain the existing owner's read-only rule, no forms/accounts/consent/payment; screenshots in-session only. January 9-11 2027 one-adult public fares verified for Paris Nord-Amsterdam/Berlin, Paris Lyon-Lyon Part Dieu/Barcelona/Geneva, Brussels Midi-Amsterdam and Geneva-Zurich HB. March 20-22 Paris-Amsterdam final selected Check your trip pane also observed. Den Haag uses the reviewed Amsterdam gateway only, no onward transfer included. Timetable-only Zurich/Lyon-Barcelona and invalid guessed station codes were not added. P12 retains safe start fragments and accepts reviewed gateway cities; deterministic NS checkpoint remains an explicitly unverified distinct overview/review path, never the shared results URL. See docs/evidence/transport.md. R6-02 H render evidence 2026-11-09 is scoped to Paris-Amsterdam and Geneva-Zurich only; other routes/gateways remain unverified alternatives, never primary without a verified candidate.

adapters.success_evidence: Observed 2026-11-09: Paris Gare du Nord to Amsterdam Central, Jan 9-11 2027, one Adult (26-59 years), public outbound times and EUR fares. March 20-22 final Check your trip pane showed both selected trips and EUR90 total on the unchanged results URL. Only one adult in this default age category is reviewed. Den Haag uses Amsterdam Centraal as gateway: mention onward transfer is out of scope, never claim it included, invent Den Haag page evidence or replace expected.city. P12 verifies either race city or reviewed gateway with all other evidence unchanged. STOP after selecting BOTH legs and fares with exact dates, party and full round-trip total, before Enter your details. No distinct post-selection path/query was observed, so the overview/review URL checkpoint remains unverified. Shared result lists and EUR0.00 are not READY.
adapters.blocked_evidence: At the first loaded NS booking page, if the reviewed route, both dates or party are absent/reset, STOP BLOCKED date_mismatch immediately. Never submit search forms or reconstruct a lost route. Block reset/stale search, wrong dates/party, no connections/fares, sales horizon, unmatched age category, non-reviewed gateway, login, captcha, required consent or form submission. R4-02's fragment-loss startup limitation is fixed by merged P12 plus task keep_fragment=true, not live-retested here. The remaining distinct checkpoint URL is unverified: never open passenger details to find it. Never follow a prohibited carrier-host redirect even when that carrier is named on an NS fare.
